subject: Availability tier pricing sculpting
messages:
From: Alicia Vega <alicia@brightgrid.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@brightgrid.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: SLA and premium support ask for POC / small pilot

Hi Ben —

Thanks again for last week's demo. We're lining up internal stakeholders for a 3-month pilot (customer-facing production subset) and need a tighter view on availability/response pricing so we can sign internal approvals. High level:

- Pilot footprint: ~40k token/day average, spikes to 140k token/day; single US region.
- Desired coverage window: 24x7 for Gold tier for a slice of traffic, 8x5 for non-critical workloads.
- Questions: uptime bands with crediting, guaranteed response times (P1/P2), named escalation path (phone + CSM), and delta pricing for adding active failover across region.

Can you send two things by EOD Friday (our procurement deadline):
1) A compact options table (three tiers) that maps uptime % -> response SLA -> monthly cost or committed discount.
2) Any pilot concessions (credits, trial pricing, cancellation terms).

I've attached our internal SLA_requirements_brightgrid.xlsx for reference.

Appreciate it — Alicia

Alicia Vega
Head of Platform Ops, BrightGrid
A: +1 415-555-0147

Attachment: SLA_requirements_brightgrid.xlsx (spreadsheet, 84KB)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Vega <alicia@brightgrid.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 13:24:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SLA and premium support ask for POC / small pilot

Thanks Alicia — quick reply with a concise starting point attached (redwood_sla_options_v1.pdf) and the pricing workbook (pricing_breakdown_BrightGrid.xlsx). Summary below:

Option A — Core (no named escalation)
- Uptime: 99.9%
- Response: P1 4 business hours (8x5), P2 48 business hours
- Pricing: no change to hosted per-token rates; optional on-call add-on available

Option B — Enhanced (recommended for pilot)
- Uptime: 99.95%
- Response: P1 1 hour (24x7 phone triage), P2 6 hours
- Escalation: phone bridge + prioritized queue; named technical lead for escalations during pilot windows
- Pricing: +18% on baseline hosted unit economics, or 10% discount for a 12-month commit. Pilot: 40% off for first 3 months if committed to a follow-on quarterly volume

Option C — Premium (active failover + SLAs)
- Uptime: 99.975% with cross-region failover tested monthly
- Response: P1 30 minutes (24x7), P2 4 hours; guaranteed exec escalation within 2 hours
- Escalation: dedicated CSM + named on-call engineer; runbook alignment and weekly readiness checks
- Pricing: +35% on baseline or custom reserved capacity pricing (we can show TCO vs Dedicated)

Notes and trade-offs:
- SLA credits: standard crediting formula in doc; we can tighten language but that impacts commercial exposure.
- Emergency peak protection (burst reserve) can be sold as a meter or a capped monthly surcharge.
- We will include pilot termination terms (7-day notice) and a single round of product change requests during pilot at no charge.

Next steps: If any of these look reasonable, I'll have Naomi draft the tightened credit language and Karthik model the margin/discount impact. Would you prefer a single consolidated quote or separate line items per tier?

— Ben

Ben Carter
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 650-555-0199
Attachment: redwood_sla_options_v1.pdf (PDF, 128KB); pricing_breakdown_BrightGrid.xlsx (spreadsheet, 96KB)

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alicia Vega <alicia@brightgrid.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SLA and premium support ask for POC / small pilot

Looping in a couple of quick commercial guardrails from Legal/Revenue ops before we finalize:

- Tighten SLA credit definition to a per-instance cap (e.g., max 12% of monthly invoice) for Option B and C. Anything uncapped goes to Exec approval.
- For Gold/Option C, add an "Emergency Response Add-on" priced as flat monthly fee rather than % uplift — easier to forecast and reduces per-token volatility. Propose $6k/month pilot add-on.
- Call out that cross-region failover requires a scheduled DR test once per quarter — if BrightGrid opts out, the warranty on 99.975% is void for that month.

Karthik — can you run the margin sensitivity on Option B with the 10% annual commit vs. the 40% pilot credit? I can draft the revised credit language and the add-on blurb.

Naomi
Head of Commercial Operations | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai

On a related note, Alicia: we can compress the document into a single consolidated quote if that helps procurement workflow (DocuSign-ready).

From: Alicia Vega <alicia@brightgrid.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@brightgrid.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 03 Dec 2026 08:17:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SLA and premium support ask for POC / small pilot

Thanks Ben/Naomi — this is helpful. A few clarifications from our side before legal: 

- We can accept the 10% annual commit structure for Option B if the pilot credit (40%) is applied as a straight one-time invoice credit at the start of the first month.
- For Option C, BrightGrid needs 99.95% minimum (we cannot commit to 99.975% for all traffic). Can we map Tiering so that 99.975% only applies to the named critical route(s) (up to 25% of traffic)?
- Credit cap: procurement is comfortable with a 10% cap during pilot; beyond that will need Exec sign-off (we can escalate).

Procurement also shared a closed-window for PO approval: 2026-12-10. If we want to meet that, can you send consolidated quote + DocuSign draft by Monday 2026-12-07 EOD?

Attachment: Procurement_calendar_Q4.pdf (calendar export, 12KB)

Alicia

Subject: Re: SLA and premium support ask for POC / small pilot

Perfect — thanks for the clarifications, Alicia. Action items and commitments from our side: 

1) Consolidated quote (Option B with tiered routing + Option C applied only to named critical route up to 25%) — DocuSign-ready single document by Monday 2026-12-07 EOD. (Naomi to draft tightened credit cap to 10% for pilot; Legal to review).
2) Pilot pricing mechanics: apply one-time 40% invoice credit at billing start; subsequent billing at negotiated Option B economics (or reserved capacity quote if you choose to move to Dedicated).
3) Emergency Response Add-on priced at $6k/month (optional) — included in the quote as a selectable SKU.
4) Technical readiness: Karthik will propose the failover runbook and a scheduling window for one cross-region DR test during pilot; if you opt out of the test, 99.975% warranty is not offered for that month.

I'll schedule a 30-minute exec alignment call for Monday morning with your procurement/legal — proposed invite shortly. If we need to tighten anything further I can update the DocuSign before sending.

Thanks again — looking forward to closing this pilot.

— Ben
